transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for joining. As we all know, the monthly cross-team case-review forum was paused after participants raised concerns about how discussions were handled, and the plan is to resume it this quarter so teams can share case lessons and coordinate responses. Since I have the authority to approve the relaunch structure, facilitator, and participation process, I'd like to use this conversation to work through what we need in place. The relaunch policy requires that we document participant safeguards and the initial review period before I can sign off. So I'd like to hear from each of you — what do you know about the concerns that were raised, and what do you think needs to be addressed before we can relaunch?

What I witnessed — the chair copying a participant's confidential case comment into a team chat — suggests a lapse in handling sensitive information appropriately. If participants can't trust that their case comments stay within the forum, the whole purpose of sharing lessons and coordinating responses is undermined. A neutral facilitator would help rebuild that trust and reduce concerns about confidentiality going forward. I'd also suggest we document what happened and the steps taken in response as part of the participant safeguards record, so it's clear how we're addressing the issue before relaunch.

commitments.detail: A neutral facilitator will be appointed for the resumed forum sessions, replacing the current chair, to rebuild trust after the confidentiality breach.
Anonymous written questions will be accepted in advance of the first two resumed sessions, collected and reviewed by the neutral facilitator before each session.
Leah will collect confidential participant feedback immediately after the second resumed session to assess whether safeguards are working before moving beyond the initial review period.

The confidentiality incident, the neutral facilitator appointment, the anonymous questions process, and the feedback collection plan will all be documented as participant safeguards in the forum plan before relaunch approval.
